The digital version gives you a unique experience of the daily issue with all articles, news and features in a smooth way where you can enjoy reading your favorite pages with the ability to search and share news anytime and anywhere as a synonym for the paper version. In addition to that, you can now read without the Internet once you download the issue you desire. Enjoy this and other features that you will experience when downloading the App.

On 10 May 1980, the first issue of "Al Bayan" newspaper was published to form a continuous journey during the four decades of a journalism school that produced generations of journalists at the level of the UAE and the Arab world. The newspaper, which is affiliated with Dubai Media Incorporated, is published daily in print and digital copies, reaching a wide audience in the Emirates and throughout the Arab world and the world.
